description: Search real estate listings. Filter by city, price, bedrooms, property type, or a specific agency/company. Returns TuLugar listings first, then "En otros sitios": homes on agency websites (RE/MAX, Century 21, Rent-A-House) in the same place, shown on the same map.

amenities.description: Comma-separated amenities/features the property must have, in the user's own words and language, e.g. "piscina, cochera" or "pool, gym". Common ones: pool/piscina, gym/gimnasio, garden/jardín, balcony/balcón, terrace/terraza, parking/cochera, furnished/amoblado, airConditioning/aire, security/seguridad, elevator/ascensor, bbq/parrilla/quincho, laundry/lavadero. Multiple = must have all.

building.description: Building/tower NAME to list the actual units for sale/rent in it, e.g. "Petra Tower" (punctuation/accents ignored). Use this — not search_projects — when the user wants the real listings in a named building.

city.description: City name only, e.g. "Asunción" — never with the country in it

company.description: Agency/company NAME to list only their properties, e.g. "RE/MAX Urbana" (resolved automatically; punctuation/accents ignored).

country.description: Country name whenever the user gives it or it is clear, e.g. "Costa Rica" for "San José Costa Rica", "Argentina" for "Córdoba, Argentina".

price_currency.description: Currency of min_price/max_price: USD (default), PYG, ARS, BRL, MXN … — e.g. PYG for "hasta Gs. 3.000.000".

name: search_listings
title: Search Listings
